message: Every automatic route must name a workflow it can actually reach. This check reads each route's structured engine-targets and goes red when a model-reachable route names no target at all, when a target marked active does not exist on disk, or when a target is malformed (unknown kind, missing ref, unrecognized availability, or a module-conditional target with no owner). Targets marked module-conditional or home-only are allowed to be absent. To fix: correct the reference, add the missing target, or mark a legitimately-absent target module-conditional/home-only.
